subject: Validate PUBLISH and MODULE payload lengths against packet size (#3972)
reason: This change only hardens the cluster-bus packet validator (clusterIsValidPacket in src/cluster_legacy.c) against integer-overflow from attacker-controlled length fields (channel_len/message_len/module payload len) in FORGED PUBLISH/PUBLISHSHARD/MODULE packets. The new reject branches fire only for malformed packets whose declared lengths don't match the packet size; legitimate bus traffic is always well-formed (totlen == explen) and passes validation identically on both builds, producing no reply, data, resync, or liveness difference. Reaching the changed code requires writing raw, length-wrap
